digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator results and manifest rendering
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, fuse, and outcome sections must be finalized with exact pass tallies and cursor behavior while preserving existing mutation fields as an additive contract ignorable by older readers.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain ineligible for advancement and eligible for re-observation in later passes.

The repair_at_write_boundary call must execute after staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent race conditions with tombstone retirement intent.
Mixed-pass tallies must report disjoint applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered buckets with exact counts, achieved by un-folding the legacy applied fold downstream in reconcile.
All diagnostic output in logs and manifests must be redacted of secrets and bounded in collection size without exceeding the reconcile.py 800-line cap via behavior-preserving extraction.
